title: Change a record's owner
goal: Move a record to a new owner with the right start date and reason.

steps.title: Open the record
steps.instruction: In the record list, click View on the record you are changing.
steps.why: You change the owner on the record itself, not from the list.
steps.expect: The record page opens with its details.

steps.title: Start the change
steps.why: The change form keeps a history, so the old owner stays on record.

commonMistakes.say: Edit Details changes the record's fields. The owner is changed with Change Owner.

steps.title: Set the start date
steps.instruction: Enter the date the new owner takes over in Effective Date.
steps.why: The date controls when reports and approvals move to the new owner.

steps.title: Pick the reason
steps.why: The reason tells auditors why ownership moved.

steps.title: Choose the new owner
steps.instruction: Type the new owner's name in New Owner.
steps.why: Only the named owner gets the record's tasks from the start date.

steps.title: Submit the change
steps.expect: A banner says the change was submitted.

steps.title: Tell the new owner
steps.instruction: Let the new owner know the record is theirs from the start date.
steps.why: They need to pick up open tasks on day one.

callouts.say: Use the first day of a pay period as the effective date.

recap.summary: You moved a record to a new owner and told them.
nextSteps: Check tomorrow that the record shows the new owner.
